quizzes.title: UPSC NDA (II) 2023 - Mathematics Official Question Paper
quizzes.description: Authentic UPSC NDA & NA II 2023 Mathematics Paper. 120 Questions | 2.5 Hours | Total Marks: 300. Marking Scheme: +2.5 marks for correct, -0.8333 (1/3 of 2.5) deduction for incorrect, 0 for unattempted.

questions.text: What is the locus of z such that |z - 1 - i| = |z + 1 + i| where z is a complex number?
options: A straight line passing through origin
questions.explanation: |z - (1+i)| = |z - (-1-i)| represents the perpendicular bisector of the line segment joining (1,1) and (-1,-1), which passes through the origin.

questions.text: What is the remainder when (1! + 2! + 3! + 4! + ... + 100!) is divided by 24?
questions.explanation: For n >= 4, n! is divisible by 24 (since 4! = 24). So remainder is (1! + 2! + 3!) mod 24 = (1 + 2 + 6) mod 24 = 9.

questions.text: If a, b, c are in Geometric Progression (GP) with common ratio r where 0 < r < 1, then a + b, 2b, b + c are in:
options: Neither AP nor GP nor HP
questions.explanation: Since b = ar, c = ar^2, we have (a+b) = a(1+r), 2b = 2ar, (b+c) = ar(1+r). Taking reciprocals shows 1/(a+b) + 1/(b+c) = 2/(2b), so they are in HP.

questions.text: What is the number of real roots of the equation x^4 - 4x - 1 = 0?
questions.explanation: Let f(x) = x^4 - 4x - 1. f'(x) = 4x^3 - 4 = 0 => x = 1. f(1) = -4 < 0. As x -> inf, f(x) -> inf; as x -> -inf, f(x) -> inf. Thus f(x) crosses zero twice, yielding 2 real roots.

questions.text: If A = {x ∈ R : x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0} and B = {x ∈ R : x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0}, what is (A ∪ B) \ (A ∩ B)?
questions.explanation: A = {2, 3}, B = {3, 4}. A ∪ B = {2, 3, 4}, A ∩ B = {3}. Symmetric difference = {2, 4}.

questions.text: Consider a matrix A of order 3x3 such that det(A) = 5. What is det(2 * adj(A)) equal to?
If the roots of x^2 - bx + c = 0 are two consecutive integers, then what is b^2 - 4c equal to?
questions.explanation: Let roots be k and k+1. Difference of roots = 1. (alpha - beta)^2 = (alpha + beta)^2 - 4*alpha*beta = b^2 - 4c = 1^2 = 1.

questions.text: In how many ways can a committee of 5 members be formed from 6 men and 4 women such that at least 3 women are included?
questions.explanation: Case 1: 3 women and 2 men = 4C3 * 6C2 = 4 * 15 = 60. Case 2: 4 women and 1 man = 4C4 * 6C1 = 1 * 6 = 6. Total = 60 + 6 = 66.

questions.text: What is the expansion coefficient of x^7 in (1 - 2x + x^2)^5?
If log_10(2), log_10(2^x - 1), log_10(2^x + 3) are in Arithmetic Progression (AP), then what is the value of x?
What is the sum of all two-digit numbers which when divided by 4 yield 1 as remainder?
If matrix A = [[0, 1], [-1, 0]], then what is A^4 equal to?
What is the value of det([[1, a, b+c], [1, b, c+a], [1, c, a+b]])?
questions.explanation: Add C3 -> C3 + C2 gives 3rd column as (a+b+c, a+b+c, a+b+c) which is a multiple of 1st column (1, 1, 1). Two proportional columns make det = 0.

questions.text: If a, b are roots of x^2 - p(x + 1) - c = 0, then what is (1 + a)(1 + b) equal to?
How many terms are there in the expansion of (x + y + z)^10?
If standard deviation of x_1, x_2, ..., x_n is σ, then what is the standard deviation of 2x_1 + 3, 2x_2 + 3, ..., 2x_n + 3?
questions.explanation: Standard deviation is invariant under shift of origin (+3) and scales directly by multiplying factor (|2|). New SD = 2σ.

questions.text: If tan(A) = 1/2 and tan(B) = 1/3, what is the value of A + B?
What is the maximum value of 3 sin(x) + 4 cos(x) + 5?
questions.explanation: Max value of a sin x + b cos x is sqrt(a^2 + b^2) = sqrt(3^2 + 4^2) = 5. Max of 5 + 5 = 10.

questions.text: What is sin(15°) equal to?
What is the principal value of sin^-1(sin(2π/3))?
questions.explanation: Range of sin^-1 is [-π/2, π/2]. sin(2π/3) = sin(π - π/3) = sin(π/3). Thus sin^-1(sin(π/3)) = π/3.

questions.text: What is lim_{x -> 0} (sin(x) / x)^(1/x^2) equal to?
questions.explanation: Form 1^inf. L = exp( lim_{x->0} (sin x / x - 1)/x^2 ) = exp( lim_{x->0} (sin x - x)/x^3 ). By Taylor series sin x = x - x^3/6 => L = e^(-1/6).

questions.text: What is lim_{x -> 0} (1 - cos(2x)) / x^2 equal to?
If f(x) = |x - 1| + |x - 2|, at how many points in R is f(x) non-differentiable?
questions.explanation: Absolute value terms |x - a| have corner points where derivative is undefined. Here corner points are x = 1 and x = 2.

questions.text: What is the derivative of sec(x) with respect to x?
questions.explanation: Standard calculus derivative: d/dx(sec x) = sec x tan x.

questions.text: What is the value of ∫ (1 / (1 + x^2)) dx from 0 to 1?
questions.explanation: ∫ (1/(1+x^2)) dx = tan^-1(x). Evaluated from 0 to 1 gives tan^-1(1) - tan^-1(0) = π/4 - 0 = π/4.

questions.text: What is the area bounded by the curve y = x^2 and the line y = 4?
What is the order and degree of the differential equation (d^2y/dx^2)^3 + (dy/dx)^4 + y = 0?
questions.explanation: Highest derivative is d^2y/dx^2 (Order = 2). Power raised to highest derivative is 3 (Degree = 3).

questions.text: What is the integrating factor of the linear differential equation dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x)?
questions.explanation: Standard integrating factor for 1st order linear ODE is I.F. = e^(∫ P(x) dx).

questions.text: If f(x) = x^3 - 3x^2 + 3x - 100, then f(x) is:
options: Increasing for x > 1 and decreasing for x < 1
questions.explanation: f'(x) = 3x^2 - 6x + 3 = 3(x - 1)^2 >= 0 for all x ∈ R, with zero only at isolated point x = 1. Thus f(x) is strictly increasing.

questions.text: What is the value of ∫_{-π}^{π} sin^3(x) cos^2(x) dx?
questions.explanation: f(x) = sin^3(x) cos^2(x) is an odd function because f(-x) = sin^3(-x) cos^2(-x) = -f(x). Integral of odd function over symmetric interval [-a, a] is 0.

questions.text: What is the distance between the parallel lines 3x + 4y - 5 = 0 and 6x + 8y + 15 = 0?
questions.explanation: Rewrite first line: 6x + 8y - 10 = 0. Distance d = |c1 - c2| / sqrt(a^2 + b^2) = |-10 - 15| / sqrt(6^2 + 8^2) = 25 / 10 = 5/2.

questions.text: What is the equation of the circle centered at (2, -3) and passing through (5, 1)?
What is the eccentricity of the hyperbola x^2/9 - y^2/16 = 1?
What is the angle between the vectors a = i + j - k and b = i - j + k?
If a and b are unit vectors such that |a + b| = 1, then what is |a - b| equal to?
What is the projection of vector a = 2i + 3j + 2k on vector b = i + 2j + k?
What is the perpendicular distance of point (1, 2, 3) from the plane x + 2y + 2z - 5 = 0?
The direction cosines of a line equally inclined to the coordinate axes are:
questions.explanation: l^2 + m^2 + n^2 = 1. Since line is equally inclined, l = m = n => 3l^2 = 1 => l = ±1/√3.

questions.text: What is the magnitude of vector cross product |a × b| if |a| = 4, |b| = 5, and a . b = 12?
What is the scalar triple product [a b c] if a = i, b = j, c = k?
questions.explanation: [i j k] = i . (j × k) = i . i = 1.

questions.text: Two dice are thrown simultaneously. What is the probability that the sum of numbers obtained is 8?
questions.explanation: Favorable pairs for sum 8: (2,6), (3,5), (4,4), (5,3), (6,2) -> 5 outcomes. Total = 36. P = 5/36.

questions.text: If P(A) = 0.4, P(B) = 0.5, and P(A ∩ B) = 0.2, what is P(A|B)?
If events A and B are independent, which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: By definition, two events A and B are independent if and only if P(A ∩ B) = P(A) * P(B).

questions.text: A bag contains 5 red and 3 green balls. If 2 balls are drawn at random without replacement, what is the probability that both are red?
What is the mean of first n natural numbers?
questions.explanation: Sum = n(n+1)/2. Mean = Sum / n = (n + 1) / 2.

questions.text: What is the variance of first n natural numbers?
questions.explanation: Standard statistical formula for variance of 1, 2, ..., n is (n^2 - 1) / 12.

questions.text: If the mean of a binomial distribution is 4 and variance is 3, what is the value of parameter n?
If two regression lines are 3x + 2y - 26 = 0 and 6x + y - 31 = 0, what is the mean of x?
questions.explanation: Regression lines intersect at (mean_x, mean_y). Solving 3x + 2y = 26 and 6x + y = 31 gives x = 4, y = 7.

questions.text: If coefficient of correlation between x and y is 0.8, what is the correlation between 2x and -3y?
questions.explanation: Correlation coefficient is invariant under change of scale except when signs differ. Multiplying one variable by +2 and other by -3 changes sign: r' = -0.8.

questions.text: What is the probability of getting 53 Sundays in a leap year?
questions.explanation: Leap year has 366 days = 52 weeks + 2 extra days. Extra days can be (Sun,Mon), (Mon,Tue), (Tue,Wed), (Wed,Thu), (Thu,Fri), (Fri,Sat), (Sat,Sun). 2 out of 7 contain Sunday.

quizzes.description: 25 PYQs on Electric Charges & Fields, Electric Potential & Capacitance, and Current Electricity. +4 for Correct, -1 for Incorrect.

questions.text: Two point charges +q and +4q are separated by distance L. Where should a third charge Q be placed on the line joining them so that it experiences zero net electrostatic force?
questions.explanation: Force balance: k(q)(Q)/x² = k(4q)(Q)/(L-x)² => (L-x)/x = 2 => L - x = 2x => x = L/3 from charge +q.

questions.text: Electric field intensity at distance r on the axis of a thin uniformly charged ring of radius R and charge Q is maximum at r equal to:
questions.explanation: Electric field on ring axis: E = k Q r / (r² + R²)^(3/2). Setting dE/dr = 0 yields r = R / √2.

questions.text: A point charge q is placed at one corner of a cube of side a. The total electric flux passing through the cube is:
questions.explanation: 8 identical cubes meet at a corner. By Gauss's Law, the flux through one entire cube is q / (8 ε₀).

questions.text: An electric dipole of dipole moment p is aligned at 30° with a uniform electric field E. The magnitude of torque acting on the dipole is:
questions.explanation: Torque τ = p E sin θ = p E sin(30°) = pE / 2.

questions.text: Work done in rotating an electric dipole of moment p in a uniform electric field E from θ = 0° to θ = 180° is:
questions.explanation: Work W = -pE (cos 180° - cos 0°) = -pE (-1 - 1) = 2 pE.

questions.text: A spherical conducting shell of radius R carries charge Q. Electric potential at any interior point at distance r < R from center is:
questions.explanation: Electric field inside conductor E = 0, so potential is uniform and equal to surface potential V = Q / (4πε₀R).

questions.text: Two capacitors of 2 µF and 4 µF are connected in series across a 120 V DC supply. Potential difference across the 2 µF capacitor is:
questions.explanation: In series, voltage divides inversely with capacitance: V₁ = V × C₂ / (C₁ + C₂) = 120 × 4 / 6 = 80 V.

questions.text: A parallel plate capacitor with plate area A and separation d is filled with a dielectric slab of constant K. Its capacitance becomes:
questions.explanation: Capacitance increases K times upon dielectric insertion: C = K C₀ = K ε₀ A / d.

questions.text: A 4 µF capacitor charged to 100 V is connected in parallel with an uncharged 6 µF capacitor. Common potential after connection is:
questions.explanation: Common potential V = (C₁ V₁ + C₂ V₂) / (C₁ + C₂) = (4×100 + 6×0) / 10 = 40 V.

questions.text: Electrostatic energy stored per unit volume in a region of electric field E in vacuum is:
questions.explanation: Energy density u_E = ½ ε₀ E².

questions.text: A wire of resistance R is stretched uniformly until its length becomes 2 times its initial length. Its new resistance will be:
questions.explanation: Volume V = A × L is constant. When L' = 2L, A' = A/2. New resistance R' = ρ (2L) / (A/2) = 4 (ρ L / A) = 4 R.

questions.text: Drift velocity v_d of free electrons in a metallic conductor varies with applied electric field E as:
questions.explanation: Drift velocity v_d = (e E / m) τ => v_d is directly proportional to E.

questions.text: Three resistors of 2 Ω, 3 Ω, and 6 Ω are connected in parallel. Their net equivalent resistance is:
Kirchhoff's Junction Law (KCL) and Loop Law (KVL) express conservation of respectively:
questions.explanation: KCL represents conservation of electric charge, KVL represents conservation of energy.

questions.text: Four resistances P = 10 Ω, Q = 20 Ω, R = 15 Ω, S = 30 Ω form a Wheatstone bridge loop. The bridge status is:
questions.explanation: Ratio P/Q = 10/20 = 1/2 and R/S = 15/30 = 1/2. Since P/Q = R/S, the bridge is balanced.

questions.text: A cell of EMF E and internal resistance r is connected to load resistor R. Maximum power is transferred to R when:
questions.explanation: Maximum Power Transfer Theorem states power to load R is maximum when load R equals internal resistance r.

questions.text: A potentiometer wire of length 10 m has resistance 20 Ω connected in series with a 3 V battery and 10 Ω resistor. Potential gradient is:
questions.explanation: Current I = 3 / (20 + 10) = 0.1 A. V_wire = I R_wire = 0.1 × 20 = 2 V. Potential gradient k = 2 / 10 = 0.2 V/m.

questions.text: Two electric bulbs rated 220 V - 60 W and 220 V - 100 W are connected in series across 220 V line. Which bulb glows brighter?
questions.explanation: Bulb resistance R = V²/P (R₆₀ > R₁₀₀). In series, current I is identical. Power P_actual = I² R => 60 W bulb dissipates more power and glows brighter.

questions.text: If temperature coefficient of resistance is 0.00125 /°C and resistance at 27°C is 1 Ω, at what temperature will resistance become 2 Ω?
In an RC charging circuit, the time required for capacitor charge to reach 63.2% of its maximum steady-state charge is:
questions.explanation: Q(t) = Q_max (1 - e^(-t/RC)). At t = RC = τ, Q = Q_max (1 - 1/e) ≈ 0.632 Q_max.

questions.text: Electric field intensity at distance r from an infinitely long straight wire carrying uniform linear charge density λ is:
questions.explanation: Applying Gauss's Law around a cylindrical surface yields E = λ / (2πε₀ r).

questions.text: Three identical capacitors of capacitance C are connected in a triangle network. Equivalent capacitance between any two corners is:
questions.explanation: Two capacitors in series (C/2) are in parallel with the third (C): C_eq = C + C/2 = 3C/2.

questions.text: An electron enters horizontally between two horizontal parallel charged plates. Its path inside the uniform electric field is:
questions.explanation: Constant horizontal velocity combined with constant vertical acceleration (a_y = eE/m) produces a parabolic trajectory.

questions.text: Equivalent resistance between opposite corners of a cube made of 12 identical wires each of resistance R is:
questions.explanation: Using nodal symmetry across body diagonal: R_eq = (1/3 + 1/6 + 1/3) R = 5R / 6.

quizzes.title: JEE Mains 2025/2026 - Chemistry Test 1 (Physical Chemistry)
quizzes.description: 25 PYQs on Chemical Kinetics, Solutions, and Electrochemistry. +4 for Correct, -1 for Incorrect.

questions.text: For a first-order reaction, the time required for 99.9% completion is approximately how many times its half-life (t_1/2)?
In Arrhenius equation k = A e^(-Ea/RT), a plot of ln k versus 1/T gives a straight line with slope equal to:
questions.explanation: Taking natural log: ln k = ln A - (Ea/R)(1/T). Slope m = -Ea / R.

questions.text: Acid hydrolysis of ethyl acetate (CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O -> CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH) in excess water is an example of:
questions.explanation: Water is present in large excess, so its concentration remains practically constant, making it pseudo-first order.

questions.text: According to Raoult's law, relative lowering of vapor pressure of a solution containing a non-volatile solute is equal to:
questions.explanation: (P° - P)/P° = x_solute (mole fraction of non-volatile solute).

questions.text: Which of the following liquid pairs forms a solution showing POSITIVE deviation from Raoult's law?
questions.explanation: Ethanol has strong H-bonding. Adding acetone breaks some H-bonds, weakening A-B interactions compared to A-A and B-B, giving positive deviation.

questions.text: The Van 't Hoff factor (i) for a completely dissociated K₄[Fe(CN)₆] solute in dilute aqueous solution is:
questions.explanation: K₄[Fe(CN)₆] dissociates into 4 K⁺ + [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻ (5 ions total) => i = 5.

questions.text: Two solutions are ISOTONIC at a given temperature when they have identical:
questions.explanation: Isotonic solutions exert equal osmotic pressure (π₁ = π₂) at a given temperature.

questions.text: Depression in freezing point ΔT_f is related to molality m of non-volatile solute by:
questions.explanation: Colligative property formula for freezing point depression: ΔT_f = i K_f m.

questions.text: Standard electrode potential E° for Cell: Zn(s) | Zn²⁺(aq) || Cu²⁺(aq) | Cu(s) with E°(Zn²⁺/Zn) = -0.76 V and E°(Cu²⁺/Cu) = +0.34 V is:
The relationship between standard Gibbs free energy change ΔG° and cell potential E°_cell is:
questions.explanation: Thermodynamic relation for electrochemical cell: ΔG° = -n F E°_cell.

questions.text: SI unit of molar conductivity (Λ_m) is:
options: S cm² mol⁻¹ (or S m² mol⁻¹)
questions.explanation: Molar conductivity unit is Siemens meter² per mole (S m² mol⁻¹ or S cm² mol⁻¹).

questions.text: Kohlrausch's Law of independent migration of ions states that at infinite dilution, limiting molar conductivity of an electrolyte is:
questions.explanation: Λ°_m = ν₊ λ°₊ + ν₋ λ°₋ (sum of limiting molar conductivities of constituent cations and anions).

questions.text: Mass of copper (At. wt = 63.5) deposited at cathode when a current of 9.65 A is passed through CuSO₄ solution for 1000 seconds is:
During discharge of a Lead Storage Battery, the chemical reaction occurring at the anode is:
questions.explanation: At the anode (oxidation): Lead metal is oxidized to lead sulfate: Pb(s) + SO₄²⁻(aq) -> PbSO₄(s) + 2e⁻.

questions.text: For a reaction A -> B, rate constant k = 2.0 × 10⁻³ s⁻¹. The order of this reaction is:
questions.explanation: The unit of rate constant is s⁻¹, which uniquely specifies a first-order reaction.

questions.text: Henry's Law constant K_H for solubility of a gas in liquid:
questions.explanation: Solubility of gas decreases as temperature increases, hence Henry's constant K_H increases with temperature.

questions.text: Which of the following colligative properties is most suitable for determining molar mass of macromolecules like proteins and polymers?
questions.explanation: Osmotic pressure produces measurable magnitude even at room temperature for very dilute macromolecular solutions.

questions.text: Variation of molar conductivity Λ_m with concentration C for a STRONG electrolyte is given by Debye-Hückel-Onsager equation:
questions.explanation: For strong electrolytes, Λ_m decreases linearly with √C: Λ_m = Λ°_m - A √C.

questions.text: In a H₂-O₂ Fuel Cell, overall reaction taking place is:
questions.explanation: Fuel cell combines hydrogen and oxygen to produce water and electricity: 2 H₂(g) + O₂(g) -> 2 H₂O(l).

questions.text: If activation energy Ea of a reaction is zero, then rate constant k is:
questions.explanation: k = A e^(-Ea/RT). If Ea = 0, e^0 = 1 => k = A.

questions.text: Unit of rate constant for a SECOND order reaction is:
questions.explanation: Rate = k [A]² => k = Rate / [A]² = (mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹) / (mol L⁻¹)² = L mol⁻¹ s⁻¹.

questions.text: The freezing point of 0.1 m aqueous solution of NaCl (assuming 100% dissociation, K_f = 1.86 K kg mol⁻¹) is:
Maximum boiling azeotrope is formed by liquid mixture showing:
questions.explanation: Negative deviation lowers vapor pressure below expected, raising boiling point to a maximum (e.g. HNO₃ + H₂O).

questions.text: Amount of electricity required to reduce 1 mole of Cr₂O₇²⁻ to Cr³⁺ in acidic medium is:
questions.explanation: Cr₂O₇²⁻ (Cr = +6) + 14 H⁺ + 6 e⁻ -> 2 Cr³⁺ (Cr = +3) + 7 H₂O. Oxidation change = 2 × (6 - 3) = 6 moles of e⁻ = 6 F.

questions.text: Molar conductivity at infinite dilution (Λ°_m) for NH₄OH can be calculated using Kohlrausch Law as:
questions.explanation: Λ°(NH₄OH) = Λ°(NH₄⁺) + Λ°(OH⁻) = [Λ°(NH₄Cl) + Λ°(NaOH)] - Λ°(NaCl).

quizzes.description: 25 PYQs on Sets, Functions, Trig, Matrices, Determinants, Differentiation, Logarithms & Complex Numbers. +4 for Correct, -1 for Incorrect.

questions.text: If set A has 3 elements and set B has 4 elements, the total number of non-empty relations from set A to set B is:
questions.explanation: |A × B| = 3 × 4 = 12. Total relations = 2¹² = 4096. Total non-empty relations = 2¹² - 1 = 4095.

questions.text: Domain of real function f(x) = √(9 - x²) is:
questions.explanation: For real square root: 9 - x² ≥ 0 => x² ≤ 9 => -3 ≤ x ≤ 3, so domain is [-3, 3].

questions.text: Function f: ℝ -> ℝ defined by f(x) = x / (1 + x²) is:
questions.explanation: f(2) = 2/5 = f(1/2), so not one-one. Range is [-1/2, 1/2] ≠ ℝ, so not onto.

questions.text: Principal value of sin⁻¹(sin(2π/3)) is:
questions.explanation: sin(2π/3) = sin(π - π/3) = sin(π/3). Principal range of sin⁻¹ is [-π/2, π/2], so value is π/3.

questions.text: Angle of elevation of top of a tower from two points at distances a and b (a > b) from base in same line are 30° and 60°. Height of tower is:
questions.explanation: h/b = tan 60° = √3 and h/a = tan 30° = 1/√3. Multiplying gives (h/b)(h/a) = √3 × (1/√3) = 1 => h² = ab => h = √(ab).

questions.text: Value of determinant | 1 a a² | | 1 b b² | | 1 c c² | is equal to:
questions.explanation: Standard Vandermonde determinant identity: (a - b)(b - c)(c - a).

questions.text: If square matrix A satisfies A² - 5A + 7I = O, then its inverse A⁻¹ is given by:
questions.explanation: Multiply by A⁻¹: A - 5I + 7 A⁻¹ = O => 7 A⁻¹ = 5I - A => A⁻¹ = (5I - A) / 7.

questions.text: Derivative of y = (sin x)^(cos x) with respect to x is:
options: (sin x)^(cos x) [ cos x cot x - sin x ln(sin x) ]
(sin x)^(cos x) [ cos x - sin x ]
questions.explanation: ln y = cos x ln(sin x). Differentiating: (1/y) dy/dx = -sin x ln(sin x) + cos x (cos x / sin x). Multiply by y.

questions.text: If f(x) = |x - 1| + |x - 2|, then f(x) is NOT differentiable at:
questions.explanation: Absolute value functions |x - a| have sharp corner points (non-differentiable) at x = a.

questions.text: Value of log_0.5(x² - 5x + 6) ≥ -1 is satisfied when x belongs to:
If ω is a complex cube root of unity, then value of (1 - ω + ω²)^5 + (1 + ω - ω²)^5 is:
questions.explanation: 1 + ω + ω² = 0 => 1 + ω² = -ω and 1 + ω = -ω². First term: (-2ω)⁵ = -32 ω⁵ = -32 ω². Second term: (-2ω²)⁵ = -32 ω¹⁰ = -32 ω. Sum = -32(ω² + ω) = -32(-1) = 32.

questions.text: Modulus of complex number z = (1 + i√3) / (1 - i√3) is:
System of equations x + y + z = 6, x + 2y + 3z = 10, x + 2y + λz = μ has infinitely many solutions if:
questions.explanation: For infinite solutions, coefficient determinant Δ = 0 => λ = 3. Also Δ_z = 0 => μ = 10.

questions.text: Range of function f(x) = 3 sin x + 4 cos x + 7 is:
questions.explanation: Min value of 3 sin x + 4 cos x is -√(3²+4²) = -5. Max value is +5. Range of f(x) is [-5+7, 5+7] = [2, 12].

questions.text: If tan⁻¹ x + tan⁻¹ y + tan⁻¹ z = π, then x + y + z is equal to:
questions.explanation: Identity: tan(tan⁻¹x + tan⁻¹y + tan⁻¹z) = tan(π) = 0 => (x + y + z - xyz) / (1 - xy - yz - zx) = 0 => x + y + z = xyz.

questions.text: In a triangle ABC, inradius r and circumradius R ratio r / R for an equilateral triangle is:
questions.explanation: For equilateral triangle: r = a / (2√3) and R = a / √3 => r / R = 1 / 2.

questions.text: General solution of trigonometric equation cos 4x = cos 2x is:
questions.explanation: cos 4x - cos 2x = 0 => -2 sin 3x sin x = 0 => sin 3x = 0 (x = nπ/3) or sin x = 0 (x = nπ).

questions.text: If A and B are symmetric matrices of same order, then (AB - BA) is ALWAYS a:
questions.explanation: (AB - BA)^T = (AB)^T - (BA)^T = B^T A^T - A^T B^T = BA - AB = -(AB - BA). Thus skew-symmetric.

questions.text: If y = tan⁻¹[ (√1+x² - 1) / x ], then dy/dx at x = 0 is:
questions.explanation: Substitute x = tan θ => y = tan⁻¹[ (sec θ - 1)/tan θ ] = tan⁻¹(tan θ/2) = θ/2 = ½ tan⁻¹ x. dy/dx = 1 / 2(1 + x²). At x = 0, dy/dx = 1/2.

questions.text: Locus of complex point z such that |z - 1| = |z + i| is a line with equation:
If f(x) is continuous at x = 0 where f(x) = (e^(3x) - 1) / x for x ≠ 0, then f(0) must equal:
questions.explanation: lim_{x->0} (e^(3x) - 1)/x = 3. For continuity, f(0) = limit = 3.

questions.text: Number of proper subsets of a set containing 5 elements is:
questions.explanation: Total subsets = 2⁵ = 32. Proper subsets = 2⁵ - 1 = 31.

questions.text: Value of log₂ 3 × log₃ 4 × log₄ 5 × ... × log₃₁ 32 is:
questions.explanation: By change of base formula: (ln 3 / ln 2) × (ln 4 / ln 3) ... × (ln 32 / ln 31) = ln 32 / ln 2 = log₂ 32 = 5.

questions.text: If parametric equations are x = a t², y = 2 a t, then d²y/dx² is:
questions.explanation: dy/dx = (dy/dt)/(dx/dt) = 2a / 2at = 1/t. d²y/dx² = d(1/t)/dx = (-1/t²)(dt/dx) = (-1/t²)(1/2at) = -1 / (2 a t³).

questions.text: Determinant of an orthogonal matrix A (where A A^T = I) is always:
questions.explanation: det(A A^T) = det(A) det(A^T) = [det(A)]² = det(I) = 1 => det(A) = ±1.

quizzes.title: JEE Mains 2025/2026 - Physics Test 2 (Kinematics & Units)
quizzes.description: 25 PYQs on Units & Dimensions, Errors, Motion in 1D, and Motion in 2D. +4 for Correct, -1 for Incorrect.

questions.text: The dimensional formula of Universal Gravitational Constant G is:
questions.explanation: F = G m₁ m₂ / r² => G = F r² / m² = [M L T⁻²][L²] / [M²] = [M⁻¹ L³ T⁻²].

questions.text: Percentage error in measurement of mass is 1% and in length of a cube is 2%. Maximum percentage error in density calculation is:
questions.explanation: Density ρ = M / L³. % error Δρ/ρ = %ΔM/M + 3 (%ΔL/L) = 1% + 3(2%) = 7%.

questions.text: In Vernier callipers, 10 Vernier scale divisions equal 9 Main scale divisions (1 MSD = 1 mm). Least count of instrument is:
questions.explanation: Least Count = 1 MSD - 1 VSD = 1 mm - (9/10) mm = 0.1 mm.

questions.text: A particle moves along a straight line with position x(t) = 3t³ - 6t² + 4t. Its acceleration at t = 2 s is:
Distance traveled by a body under uniform acceleration a in the n-th second is:
A body dropped from height H reaches ground with speed v. At what height above ground is its speed v/2?
questions.explanation: v² = 2gH. At height h, v_h² = 2g(H - h) = (v/2)² = v²/4 = 2gH / 4 => H - h = H/4 => h = 3H / 4.

questions.text: A car accelerates from rest at rate α for time t₁ and then decelerates at rate β to rest in time t₂. Maximum velocity attained is:
questions.explanation: v_max = α t₁ = β t₂. Total time T = t₁ + t₂ = v_max/α + v_max/β = v_max (α+β)/(αβ) => v_max = α β T / (α + β).

questions.text: A projectile is thrown with initial velocity u at angle θ with horizontal. Maximum height H reached is:
questions.explanation: Maximum height formula H = u_y² / (2g) = u² sin²θ / (2g).

questions.text: Horizontal range of a projectile is equal to 4 times its maximum height. Angle of projection θ is:
questions.explanation: R = 4 H => (u² sin 2θ / g) = 4 (u² sin²θ / 2g) => 2 sinθ cosθ = 2 sin²θ => tan θ = 1 => θ = 45°.

questions.text: Two projectiles launched at angles θ and (90° - θ) with same speed u have horizontal ranges R₁ and R₂. The ratio R₁ : R₂ is:
questions.explanation: Complementary angles of projection with same speed produce identical horizontal ranges (R₁ = R₂ => ratio 1:1).

questions.text: A ball is projected at 60° with horizontal with speed 20 m/s. Its velocity at the highest point of its trajectory is:
questions.explanation: At highest point, vertical velocity is 0, horizontal velocity is u cos θ = 20 cos(60°) = 10 m/s.

questions.text: A swimmer can swim at 4 km/h in still water. River flows at 2 km/h. To cross river in SHORTEST TIME, swimmer must head:
questions.explanation: Shortest time to cross river occurs when swimmer directs full swimming speed perpendicular to river current.

questions.text: Centripetal acceleration of a particle moving in a circle of radius R with constant speed v is:
questions.explanation: Centripetal acceleration formula a_c = v² / R = ω² R.

questions.text: A particle completes one full circle of radius R in time T. Its average velocity over one complete revolution is:
questions.explanation: Net displacement after one complete revolution is zero, so average velocity = displacement / T = 0.

questions.text: Equation of trajectory of a projectile is y = √3 x - (g x² / 2). Angle of projection θ is:
questions.explanation: Comparing with trajectory equation y = x tan θ - ..., tan θ = √3 => θ = 60°.

questions.text: Dimensional formula of Planck's constant h is same as that of:
questions.explanation: Planck's constant h and Angular momentum L both have dimensions [M L² T⁻¹].

questions.text: A train 100 m long moving at 45 km/h crosses a bridge 1 km long. Time taken by train to cross bridge is:
Area under velocity-time (v-t) graph represents:
questions.explanation: Integration of velocity with respect to time ∫ v dt gives displacement.

questions.text: In non-uniform circular motion of radius R, tangential acceleration is a_t and centripetal is a_c. Net acceleration is:
questions.explanation: Tangential and centripetal accelerations are mutually perpendicular, so a_net = √(a_t² + a_c²).

questions.text: A particle moves along a circle of radius r = 2 m. Its angular speed varies as ω = 3t rad/s. Tangential acceleration at t = 2 s is:
questions.explanation: Angular acceleration α = dω/dt = 3 rad/s². Tangential acceleration a_t = α r = 3 × 2 = 6 m/s².

questions.text: Optimum banking angle θ for a curved road of radius R for speed v without relying on friction is:
questions.explanation: Banking equation tan θ = v² / (R g) => θ = tan⁻¹(v² / (R g)).

questions.text: Rain is falling vertically downwards with speed 4 m/s. A man runs horizontally at 3 m/s. Relative velocity of rain w.r.t man is:
questions.explanation: v_relative = √(v_rain² + v_man²) = √(4² + 3²) = 5 m/s. Angle tan θ = 3/4 => θ = 37° with vertical.

questions.text: If physical quantity X = A² B / C³, maximum fractional error ΔX / X is:
questions.explanation: Errors always add in worst-case analysis: ΔX/X = 2(ΔA/A) + (ΔB/B) + 3(ΔC/C).

questions.explanation: Slope of distance vs time graph is ds/dt = Speed.

questions.text: A particle is thrown vertically upwards with speed u. Total time of flight before returning to ground is:
questions.explanation: Time of ascent = u/g, Time of descent = u/g. Total time of flight = 2u / g.

quizzes.title: JEE Mains 2025/2026 - Chemistry Test 2 (Atomic & Periodic)
quizzes.description: 25 High-Yield Questions on Mole Concept, Structure of Atom, and Periodic Table Trends. +4 for Correct, -1 for Incorrect.

questions.text: Total number of atoms present in 4.4 g of CO₂ gas (Molar mass = 44 g/mol) is:
questions.explanation: Moles of CO₂ = 4.4 / 44 = 0.1 mol. Each CO₂ molecule has 3 atoms. Total atoms = 0.1 × 3 × N_A = 0.3 N_A.

questions.text: If 5 moles of reactant A and 6 moles of reactant B react according to 2A + 3B -> C, the limiting reagent is:
questions.explanation: Required ratio B/A = 3/2 = 1.5. Available ratio B/A = 6/5 = 1.2 < 1.5. Hence B is in deficit and is limiting.

questions.text: Radius of the 1st orbit of H-atom is 0.529 Å. Radius of 3rd orbit of Li²⁺ ion is:
Wavelength of photon emitted during electronic transition from n = 2 to n = 1 in H-atom belongs to:
questions.explanation: Any transition ending at n = 1 belongs to the Lyman series, which lies in the UV spectral region.

questions.text: De Broglie wavelength of an electron accelerated through a potential difference of 100 V is approximately:
Total number of radial nodes for a 4d orbital is:
questions.explanation: Radial nodes = n - l - 1. For 4d: n = 4, l = 2 => Radial nodes = 4 - 2 - 1 = 1.

questions.text: Which of the following sets of quantum numbers (n, l, m_l, m_s) is IMPOSSIBLE?
questions.explanation: Azimuthal quantum number l must satisfy 0 ≤ l ≤ n-1. For n = 3, l cannot be 3.

questions.text: Correct order of IONIC RADII among isoelectronic species N³⁻, O²⁻, F⁻, Na⁺, Mg²⁺, Al³⁺ is:
options: N³⁻ > O²⁻ > F⁻ > Na⁺ > Mg²⁺ > Al³⁺
Al³⁺ > Mg²⁺ > Na⁺ > F⁻ > O²⁻ > N³⁻
Na⁺ > Mg²⁺ > Al³⁺ > N³⁻ > O²⁻ > F⁻
F⁻ > O²⁻ > N³⁻ > Na⁺ > Mg²⁺ > Al³⁺
questions.explanation: For isoelectronic species, higher nuclear charge Z pulls electrons closer, shrinking ionic radius: N³⁻ (Z=7) largest, Al³⁺ (Z=13) smallest.

questions.text: First ionization enthalpy of Nitrogen (N, Z=7) is HIGHER than Oxygen (O, Z=8) because:
questions.explanation: Nitrogen has extra stable half-filled 2p³ electronic configuration, making electron removal harder than from Oxygen (2p⁴).

questions.text: Which element has the MOST NEGATIVE electron gain enthalpy (highest electron affinity)?
questions.explanation: Chlorine has more negative electron gain enthalpy than Fluorine due to less inter-electronic repulsion in 3p subshell compared to compact 2p in F.

questions.text: IUPAC official name for the element with atomic number Z = 105 is:
questions.explanation: Element Z = 105 is officially named Dubnium (Db) (systematic name Unnilpentium).

questions.text: Which of the following oxides is AMPHOTERIC in nature?
questions.explanation: Zinc oxide (ZnO), Al₂O₃, BeO, PbO are amphoteric (react with both acids and bases).

questions.text: Number of unpaired electrons and magnetic moment of Fe³⁺ ion (Z = 26) are respectively:
questions.explanation: Fe³⁺ configuration is [Ar] 3d⁵. 5 unpaired electrons => µ = √(5 × 7) = √35 ≈ 5.92 BM.

questions.text: Equivalent weight of KMnO₄ in STRONGLY ACIDIC medium (M = Molar mass) is:
questions.explanation: In acidic medium, MnO₄⁻ (+7) + 5e⁻ -> Mn²⁺ (+2). n-factor = 5 => Equivalent weight = M / 5.

questions.text: Work function of a metal is 4.0 eV. Threshold frequency ν₀ for photoelectric effect is approximately:
questions.explanation: Work function W₀ = h ν₀ => ν₀ = (4.0 × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J) / (6.626 × 10⁻³⁴ J s) ≈ 9.66 × 10¹⁴ Hz.

questions.text: Electronegativity values of C atoms in sp, sp², and sp³ hybrid states follow the order:
questions.explanation: Higher % s-character increases electronegativity: sp (50% s) > sp² (33.3% s) > sp³ (25% s).

questions.text: Beryllium (Be) shows diagonal relationship with which element of the 3rd period?
questions.explanation: Be (Period 2, Group 2) shows diagonal relationship with Al (Period 3, Group 13) due to similar ionic potential.

questions.text: Molarity of pure water (density = 1 g/mL) at 4 °C is:
questions.explanation: 1 L water = 1000 g. Moles = 1000 / 18 = 55.55 mol. Molarity = 55.55 / 1 L = 55.55 M.

questions.text: Volume strength of a 1.5 M H₂O₂ solution is:
questions.explanation: Volume strength = 11.2 × Molarity = 11.2 × 1.5 = 16.8 Volume.

questions.text: Maximum number of electrons in an atom that can have quantum numbers n = 4, m_s = +1/2 is:
questions.explanation: Total orbitals for n = 4 is n² = 16. Each orbital holds 1 electron with spin m_s = +1/2 => 16 electrons.

questions.text: Which neutral molecule has NEITHER acidic nor basic oxide properties (NEUTRAL oxide)?
questions.explanation: CO, NO, and N₂O are neutral oxides.

questions.text: Concentration term which is INDEPENDENT of temperature is:
questions.explanation: Molality and Mole fraction involve only masses (not liquid volume), making them temperature independent.

General electronic configuration of d-block transition elements is:
questions.explanation: Standard valence electron configuration for d-block elements is (n-1)d¹⁻¹⁰ n s¹⁻².

Domain of real function f(x) = log₁₀(x² - 5x + 6) is:
questions.explanation: Logarithm argument must be strictly positive: x² - 5x + 6 > 0 => (x - 2)(x - 3) > 0 => x < 2 or x > 3.

questions.text: Range of function f(x) = 1 / (2 - sin 3x) is:
questions.explanation: Since -1 ≤ sin 3x ≤ 1 => 1 ≤ 2 - sin 3x ≤ 3. Inverting gives 1/3 ≤ f(x) ≤ 1.

questions.text: Relation R = {(a, b) ∈ ℤ × ℤ : a - b is divisible by 5} is:
options: Reflexive and Symmetric but not Transitive
questions.explanation: R is Reflexive (a-a=0 div by 5), Symmetric (a-b div by 5 => b-a div by 5), and Transitive (a-b and b-c div by 5 => a-c div by 5). Hence Equivalence.

questions.text: If 1 + i is a root of quadratic equation x² + px + q = 0 with real coefficients, then (p, q) is:
questions.explanation: Complex roots occur in conjugate pairs, so roots are 1+i and 1-i. Sum = 2 = -p => p = -2. Product = (1+i)(1-i) = 2 = q => q = 2.

questions.text: Value of (1 - ω)(1 - ω²)(1 - ω⁴)(1 - ω⁸) where ω is complex cube root of unity is:
questions.explanation: ω⁴ = ω and ω⁸ = ω². Product = [(1 - ω)(1 - ω²)]² = (1 - ω - ω² + ω³)². Since 1 + ω + ω² = 0 => -ω - ω² = 1, product = (1 + 1 + 1)² = 3² = 9.

questions.text: Value of tan 75° - cot 75° is equal to:
Base change identity: 1 / log_a(ab) + 1 / log_b(ab) is equal to:
questions.explanation: 1 / log_a(ab) = log_{ab} a and 1 / log_b(ab) = log_{ab} b. Sum = log_{ab}(a × b) = log_{ab}(ab) = 1.

questions.text: Principal argument of complex number z = -1 - i√3 is:
questions.explanation: z is in 3rd quadrant (x < 0, y < 0). tan α = |-√3 / -1| = √3 => α = π/3. Arg(z) = -(π - π/3) = -2π/3.

questions.text: Symmetric difference of two sets A and B, denoted A Δ B, is defined as:
options: Both (A \ B) ∪ (B \ A) and (A ∪ B) \ (A ∩ B)
questions.explanation: A Δ B consists of elements in A or B but not both, which equals (A \ B) ∪ (B \ A) = (A ∪ B) \ (A ∩ B).

Locus of complex point z such that Re(z²) = 0 is:
options: A pair of perpendicular straight lines (y = ± x)
questions.explanation: z = x + iy => z² = x² - y² + 2ixy. Re(z²) = x² - y² = 0 => y = ± x (perpendicular lines).

questions.text: Solution set of inequality sin x > 1/2 in interval [0, 2π] is:
questions.explanation: sin x = 1/2 at x = π/6 and 5π/6. sin x > 1/2 in 1st and 2nd quadrants between π/6 and 5π/6.

questions.text: If roots of ax² + bx + c = 0 are α and β, then quadratic equation whose roots are 1/α and 1/β is:
questions.explanation: Replace x with 1/x: a(1/x)² + b(1/x) + c = 0 => cx² + bx + a = 0.

questions.text: Maximum value of 5 sin x + 12 cos x is:
questions.explanation: Maximum value of a sin x + b cos x is √(a² + b²) = √(5² + 12²) = √169 = 13.

questions.text: If f: ℝ -> ℝ is defined by f(x) = x³, then f is:
questions.explanation: x₁³ = x₂³ => x₁ = x₂ (one-one). Every real y has cube root ∛y ∈ ℝ (onto). Bijective.

questions.text: Number of equivalence classes of relation 'congruence modulo 4' on set of integers ℤ is:
questions.explanation: Equivalence classes under mod 4 are remainders {[0], [1], [2], [3]}, total 4 classes.
